Source_Data_11.zip is available for download at the link given below due to large file size (~50 MB).
Source_Data_11.zip consists of 16 .csv files named <Trait>_AdmixProps.csv.
Each .csv file consists of 3 columns EUR, EAS, AFR while each row corresponds to a resampled SAS invidual. 
Each entry (i,j) of each .csv file denotes the admixture proportion of the i'th inidividual in the j'th population.

Link to Source_Data_11.zip: https://1drv.ms/u/c/1d2cade3bfb64a9a/IQBgAwrTFb4bQrYkFW-jca69AZy7NQvg5YU7K99H8MUNpwE?e=Jh4HP8
